nota: Diccionario ES→EN. El inglés se genera con tools\i18n.ps1 generar; no editar el .en.js a mano. keep: textos que no se traducen.

lit.\u0027 coincide con lo que se observa ex: " matches what is observed experimentally for "
lit.\u0027. Hace falta otra composición para: ". Another composition is needed to decide: that is why Werner used MA₄B₂ (2 isomers instead of 3)."
lit.\u0027\u003ch4\u003eCompruébalo tú: ¿cuá:
"

Check it yourself: how many isomers does each geometry predict?

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eAmbos modelos son \u0:
"

Both models are [Co(NH₃)₄Cl₂]⁺: same composition and the same Co–N and Co–Cl bonds, but the two Cl⁻ occupy different positions. That is geometric isomerism.

Rotate either model with the mouse: they move together.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl programa coloca lo:
"

The program places the B ligands in the six positions of each geometry and groups the placements that a rigid rotation makes equivalent. Each color of the bar is a different isomer; the number is how many placements it contains.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl programa prueba \u:
"

The program tests all 24 rigid rotations of the octahedron and animates the best one. If any made them coincide, they would be the same compound.

Here it fails: red circles remain where the ligand does not match. Cis and trans are different compounds (violet and green).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn [Co(NH₃)₃Cl₃] los:
"

In [Co(NH₃)₃Cl₃] the three Cl⁻ can cover one face of the octahedron (fac, all cis to each other) or one meridian (mer, with a trans pair and the metal in its plane). The green surface highlights it.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn el \u003cb\u003eCo:
"

In the Builder you switch each position between NH₃ and Cl⁻ and the program identifies the isomer by its geometry, not by how you drew it. Try the challenge: fac-[Co(NH₃)₃Cl₃].

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn un cuadrado plano:
"

In a square planar MA₂B₂ there are also cis and trans. Cisplatin is an antitumor drug; its trans isomer is no use as such: geometry decides biological activity.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa flecha naranja sum:
"

The orange arrow adds up the M→Cl vectors (qualitative model). In cis they do not cancel: the molecule is polar. In trans they are opposite and cancel out: it is nonpolar.

Polarity is one of the properties that allows isomers to be told apart in the laboratory.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos ejes violetas son:
"

The violet axes are calculated from the rotations that preserve the colors. Cis has a C₂ axis (group C₂ᵥ); trans has a C₄ axis (group D₄ₕ).

A rotation about the axis is animated: when it ends, the structure coincides with itself.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSe seleccionaron los:
"

The two chlorides were selected in each model: in cis they form 90° and in trans 180°. No rotation of the model changes those measurements.

You can measure any other pair by clicking two ligands.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eTodos los pares de vé:
"

All the pairs of vertices of the tetrahedron are equivalent (≈109.5°). That is why the superposition test does succeed: the two models are the same structure seen from another side.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eWerner razonó al revé:
"

Werner reasoned backwards: if only 2 isomers of MA₄B₂ are isolated, the geometry cannot be hexagonal or prismatic (both predict 3). Use the counter to check what each geometry predicts.

"
lit.\u0027al final de la página: isómeros qu: "at the bottom of the page: isomers predicted by each geometry."
lit.\u0027Con tres ligandos de cada tipo: fa: "With three ligands of each type: fac and mer"
lit.\u0027Ejes de simetría: la estructura ca: "Symmetry axes: the structure falls onto itself"
lit.\u0027El vector dipolar: cis polar, tran: "The dipole vector: cis polar, trans nonpolar"
lit.\u0027En el tetraedro no existe el par c: "In the tetrahedron the cis/trans pair does not exist"
lit.\u0027Explora los modelos arrastrando pa: "Explore the models by dragging to rotate them and clicking on the ligands to measure angles. The guided lesson (book button, or the L key) goes through the five modules step by step."
lit.\u0027Girar el modelo con el foco en él\: "Rotate the model with focus on it"
lit.\u0027prueba los 24 giros rígidos; si ni: "tests the 24 rigid rotations; if none works, they are different compounds."
lit.\u0027recorre los ejes calculados; “Gira: "cycles through the calculated axes; “Rotate” and “Look along the axis” demonstrate them."
